benefits.name: Annual Travel Credit
benefits.description: Statement credit for flexible travel purchases.
benefits.terms: Applies broadly across travel purchase categories.

benefits.name: Select Chase Travel Hotels Credit
benefits.description: Statement credit for prepaid Chase Travel hotel bookings with IHG, Montage, Pendry, Omni, Virgin, Minor, and Pan Pacific.
benefits.terms: Available Jan. 1, 2026 through Dec. 31, 2026 per current promotion; confirm this end date is still current before relying on it. Prepaid bookings via Chase Travel only.

benefits.name: The Edit by Chase Travel Credit
benefits.description: Statement credit for qualifying prepaid bookings with The Edit by Chase Travel, requiring a 2-night minimum stay.
benefits.terms: Up to $500/year, max $250 per transaction. Requires a minimum 2-night prepaid stay. Effective starting 1/1/2026.

benefits.name: TSA PreCheck / Global Entry / NEXUS Credit
benefits.description: Statement credit for a TSA PreCheck, Global Entry, or NEXUS application fee.

benefits.name: Lyft Credit
benefits.description: Monthly in-app Lyft credit.
benefits.terms: Up to $10/month ($120/year total) through Sep. 30, 2027 per current promotion; confirm this end date is still current before relying on it.

benefits.name: Airport Lounge Access
benefits.description: Complimentary access to Chase Sapphire Lounge by The Club, Priority Pass Select lounges, and Air Canada Maple Leaf Lounges/Cafés.

networks: Chase Sapphire Lounge by The Club
loungeAccessDetail.guestPolicy: Up to 2 complimentary guests at Chase Sapphire Lounges and Priority Pass lounges; 1 complimentary guest at Air Canada Maple Leaf Lounges/Cafés.

benefits.terms: Priority Pass Select membership is provisioned automatically via the Chase account.

benefits.name: IHG One Rewards Platinum Elite Status
benefits.description: Complimentary IHG One Rewards Platinum Elite status.
benefits.terms: Complimentary through Dec. 31, 2027 per current promotion; confirm this end date is still current before relying on it.

benefits.name: Google Workspace Credit
benefits.description: Annual statement credit toward a Google Workspace subscription.
benefits.terms: Through Dec. 31, 2027 per current promotion; confirm this end date is still current before relying on it.

benefits.name: ZipRecruiter Credit
benefits.description: Statement credit toward ZipRecruiter, disbursed semi-annually.
benefits.terms: Up to $200 per half-year period ($400/year total) through Dec. 31, 2027 per current promotion; confirm this end date is still current before relying on it.

benefits.name: Complimentary DashPass Membership
benefits.description: Complimentary DashPass membership from DoorDash.
benefits.terms: Through Dec. 31, 2027 per current promotion; confirm this end date is still current before relying on it. Requires activation.

benefits.name: Monthly DoorDash Promo Credits
benefits.description: Monthly DoorDash promo credits toward restaurant and grocery/retail orders.
benefits.terms: Up to $5/month in restaurant order credits and $20/month in grocery/retail order credits ($300/year total) through Dec. 31, 2027 per current promotion; confirm this end date is still current before relying on it.

benefits.name: Curated Gift Card Credit
benefits.description: Statement credit toward curated gift cards purchased via giftcards.com/reservebusiness, disbursed semi-annually.
benefits.terms: Up to $50 per half-year period ($100/year total) through Oct. 31, 2028 per current promotion; confirm this end date is still current before relying on it.

benefits.name: Cell Phone Protection
benefits.description: Coverage for damage or theft of a cell phone when the bill is paid with the card, up to $1,000 per claim, up to 3 claims per 12 months.

benefits.name: Auto Rental Collision Damage Waiver
benefits.description: Coverage for damage/theft on most rental cars, up to $75,000.

benefits.name: Trip Cancellation & Interruption Insurance
benefits.description: Reimbursement up to $10,000 per covered traveler for prepaid, non-refundable travel expenses.

benefits.name: Emergency Evacuation and Transportation Coverage
benefits.description: Coverage up to $100,000 for emergency evacuation and transportation.

benefits.name: Emergency Medical and Dental Benefit
benefits.description: Coverage up to $2,500 per covered traveler for emergency medical/dental expenses while on a covered trip, after a $50 deductible.

benefits.name: Baggage Delay Insurance
benefits.description: Up to $100 a day for up to 5 days for essential purchases when checked luggage is delayed.

benefits.name: Lost Luggage Reimbursement
benefits.description: Up to $3,000 per covered traveler for lost, damaged, or stolen checked or carry-on luggage.

benefits.name: Purchase Protection
benefits.description: Covers new purchases against damage or theft for 120 days, up to $10,000 per item.

benefits.name: Extended Warranty Protection
benefits.description: Extends eligible U.S. manufacturer warranties of 3 years or less by an additional year.

benefits.name: $120,000 Annual Spend Tier Benefits
benefits.description: Complimentary World of Hyatt Explorist status, IHG One Rewards Diamond Elite status, Southwest Rapid Rewards A-List status, up to $500 statement credit for The Shops at Chase, and up to $500 statement credit for Southwest Airlines flights booked via Chase Travel.
benefits.terms: Unlocked after $120,000 in card purchases within the calendar year.

earningRates.terms: Purchases through Chase Travel, including The Edit. Purchases qualifying for statement credits do not earn points.
Promotional rate through Sep. 30, 2027 per current terms; confirm this end date is still current before relying on it.
Flights and hotels booked directly with the airline/hotel (not through Chase Travel).
